# Advion Plugins

> Documentation and setup guides for Advion plugins.

- [Advion Plugins](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/index.md): Advion Plugins
- [UniversalStakes Wiki](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/readme.md): UniversalStakes turns surplus items and money on your server into a timed leaderboard race. Players choose an event, deposit resources, earn points, and climb the board.

## UniversalStakes Wiki

- [Troubleshooting](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/troubleshooting.md): The file must be in plugins/UniversalStakes/language/locale/stakes/, end in .yml, and have valid YAML indentation.
- [Database & safety](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/database-and-safety.md): Before updating the plugin: stop the server and back up the database. This one habit prevents most data-loss problems.
- [Reload & restart](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/reload-and-restart.md): /stakes admin reload validates every edited file before applying it. If validation fails, the currently running registry and currency definitions stay in use.
- [Configuration](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/configuration.md): This page covers the two global files: config.yml (server-wide settings) and currencies.yml (external PlaceholderAPI currencies). For the per-event files, see Stake settings.
- [Commands & permissions](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/commands-and-permissions.md): By default nobody has UniversalStakes permissions. Give regular players the bundle universalstakes.use, and give staff the bundle universalstakes.admin (operators get it automatically).
- [Messages & placeholders](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/messages-and-placeholders.md): UniversalStakes sends two kinds of chat messages: plugin-wide messages (errors, prompts, help) from messages.yml, and per-stake lifecycle messages (started, stopped, reminder) that live in each stake file.
- [Menus](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/menus.md): Simple rule: change text, icons and lore first. Do not remove a dynamic-items section unless you intentionally want to hide that list.
- [Rewards](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/rewards.md): Important: every reward command runs as the server console. Only trusted staff should edit stake files — a reward command can give items, money, or run any server command.
- [Currencies](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/currencies.md): A contribution source takes a currency block. There are four types. Pick the one that matches what players should deposit.
- [Stake settings](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/stake-settings.md): Use this page when you already have a stake file and want to understand one setting. For a copy-paste starter, use Your first stake.
- [Your first stake](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/first-stake.md): Goal: a 1-hour diamond race with one winner. The safest first event to test.
- [Installation](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/installation.md): You need: Paper 1.20.4 through 26.2, and the UniversalStakes release JAR. Use Java 21 on Paper 1.20.4–1.21.11, or Java 25 on Paper 26.1–26.2. Never use a JAR whose name contains SNAPSHOT on a live server.
- [How it works](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/how-it-works.md): This page explains the whole plugin in plain language: where the files live, what a round is, and what happens step by step when players deposit, when the timer ends, and when they claim rewards.
